name: Glass Jaw
source:
A bowl of beef noodles. That was his favourite food.
It was just enough for his last meal.

Raymond Yu decides to die, goes down fighting, and saves more than just himself.

[From [url=https://arbitrrrary.itch.io/glass-jaw]itch.io[/url]]
